model.name: openai/gpt-4.1-mini
model.about: OpenAI: GPT-4.1 Mini, through OpenRouter at $0.4 in and $1.6 out per million tokens.

answers.sql:
SELECT ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, COUNT(txn.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON txn.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT aml
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR jur ON aml.JUR_K = jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON aml.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY jur.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

SELECT br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(atm.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_disputes_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH target_date AS (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
),
clients_in_default AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
    WHERE BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM target_date)
      AND DFLT_FLG = TRUE
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM clients_in_default;

SELECT d_cmplt_ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, COUNT(f_cmplt.CMPLT_F_K) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f_cmplt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d_cmplt_ctg ON f_cmplt.CMPLT_CTG_K = d_cmplt_ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_cmplt.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_cmplt_ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
       AVG(f_fx_rt_d.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f_fx_rt_d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_fx_rt_d.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY d_ccy ON f_fx_rt_d.CCY_K = d_ccy.CCY_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, ptf_val.MKT_ID AS market_id, SUM(ptf_val.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_portfolio_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D ptf_val
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON ptf_val.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR, ptf_val.MKT_ID
ORDER BY ptf_val.MKT_ID;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code, COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE OPND_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND OPND_DT < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT br.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON txn.BR_K = br.BR_K AND br.IS_CURR = TRUE
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

-- Find the DT_K for 30 June 2025
WITH target_date AS (
    SELECT DT_K
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
    WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
),
-- Select closing balances for all accounts on that date
balances AS (
    SELECT CLSNG_BAL_AMT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN target_date t ON f.BUS_DT_K = t.DT_K
    WHERE CLSNG_BAL_AMT IS NOT NULL
)
-- Calculate average closing balance
SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM balances;

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate_usd_dec_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH txn_2025_cust AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST cust
WHERE cust.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND cust.IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND cust.CUST_K NOT IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM txn_2025_cust);

WITH auth_2025 AS (
    SELECT f.PMT_STS_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_auths,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED') AS declined_auths
    FROM auth_2025
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN total_auths = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (declined_auths::numeric / total_auths) * 100 END AS declined_percentage
FROM counts;

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name, COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS escalated_complaints_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaints_count DESC;

SELECT chnl.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, SUM(fee.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN fee
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fee.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy ON fee.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST cust ON fee.CUST_K = cust.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST chnl ON fee.CHNL_K = chnl.CUST_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY chnl.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY chnl.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(TXN_AMT), 0) AS total_transaction_amount_fraud_disputes_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dsp.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT aml
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR jur ON aml.JUR_K = jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON aml.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE aml.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY jur.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY jur.DSPLY_NM;

WITH target_date AS (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LN_ID) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS
WHERE DYS_PST_DUE > 90
  AND BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM target_date);

WITH target_date AS (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
),
-- Get the latest disbursement principal outstanding on or before target date per loan
latest_disb AS (
    SELECT
        LN_PRD_K,
        LN_ID,
        OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT,
        BUS_DT_K,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LN_ID ORDER BY BUS_DT_K DESC) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS
    WHERE BUS_DT_K <= (SELECT DT_K FROM target_date)
),
-- Get the latest repayment principal outstanding on or before target date per loan
latest_rpmt AS (
    SELECT
        LN_PRD_K,
        LN_ID,
        OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT,
        BUS_DT_K,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LN_ID ORDER BY BUS_DT_K DESC) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT
    WHERE BUS_DT_K <= (SELECT DT_K FROM target_date)
),
-- Combine disbursement and repayment to get the latest principal outstanding per loan
latest_principal AS (
    SELECT LN_PRD_K, LN_ID, OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT, BUS_DT_K FROM latest_disb WHERE rn = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT LN_PRD_K, LN_ID, OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT, BUS_DT_K FROM latest_rpmt WHERE rn = 1
),
-- For each loan, get the most recent principal outstanding record
latest_per_loan AS (
    SELECT LN_PRD_K, LN_ID, OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LN_ID ORDER BY BUS_DT_K DESC) AS rn
        FROM latest_principal
    ) sub
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(lp.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM latest_per_loan lp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON lp.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY p.DSPLY_NM;

WITH atm_txn_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        BR_K,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY BR_K
),
max_txn_per_region AS (
    SELECT
        b.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        a.BR_K,
        a.atm_txn_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.RGN_CD1 ORDER BY a.atm_txn_count DESC) AS rn
    FROM atm_txn_2025 a
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON a.BR_K = b.BR_K
    WHERE b.IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    (SELECT DSPLY_NM FROM bank_dwh.D_BR WHERE BR_K = max_txn_per_region.BR_K AND IS_CURR = TRUE LIMIT 1) AS branch_name,
    atm_txn_count
FROM max_txn_per_region
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT
  f.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
  SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_card_authorization_amount
FROM
  bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  f.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY
  total_card_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH transfers_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.CUST_K,
        SUM(COALESCE(f.STLM_AMT, 0)) AS total_wire_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY f.CUST_K
)
SELECT
    c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
    t.total_wire_amount
FROM transfers_2025 t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
ORDER BY t.total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

WITH atm_customers_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_ATM_TXN.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
    WHERE D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
wr_trf_customers_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_WR_TRF.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
    WHERE D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers_both_txn_2025
FROM atm_customers_2025 a
INNER JOIN wr_trf_customers_2025 w ON a.CUST_K = w.CUST_K;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.cal_yr_nbr AS year, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.cal_yr_nbr
ORDER BY d.cal_yr_nbr;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;

SELECT d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
       SUM(CAST(f_wr_trf.STLM_AMT AS NUMERIC)) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f_wr_trf
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_wr_trf.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY d_ccy ON f_wr_trf.CCY_K = d_ccy.CCY_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON txn.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT dj.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(fa.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT fa
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR dj ON fa.JUR_K = dj.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fa.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dj.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

SELECT br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(atm.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_disputes_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH target_date AS (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
),
latest_dflt AS (
    SELECT CUST_K, MAX(BUS_DT_K) AS max_bus_dt_k
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D, target_date
    WHERE BUS_DT_K <= (SELECT DT_K FROM target_date)
      AND DFLT_FLG = TRUE
    GROUP BY CUST_K
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
JOIN latest_dflt ld ON d.CUST_K = ld.CUST_K AND d.BUS_DT_K = ld.max_bus_dt_k
WHERE d.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT d_cc.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, COUNT(f_c.CMPLT_F_K) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f_c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d_cc ON f_c.CMPLT_CTG_K = d_cc.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_c.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_cc.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
       AVG(f_fx_rt_d.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f_fx_rt_d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_fx_rt_d.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY d_ccy ON f_fx_rt_d.CCY_K = d_ccy.CCY_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, ptf_val.MKT_ID AS market_id, SUM(ptf_val.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_portfolio_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D ptf_val
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON ptf_val.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR, ptf_val.MKT_ID
ORDER BY ptf_val.MKT_ID;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code, COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE OPND_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND OPND_DT < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT br.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON txn.BR_K = br.BR_K AND br.IS_CURR = TRUE
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

WITH target_date AS (
    SELECT DT_K
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
    WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
),
avg_closing_balance AS (
    SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
    WHERE BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM target_date)
)
SELECT avg_closing_balance
FROM avg_closing_balance;

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate_usd_dec_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH txn_2025_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST cust
WHERE cust.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND cust.IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND cust.CUST_K NOT IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM txn_2025_customers);

WITH auth_2025 AS (
    SELECT fcd.BUS_DT_K, fcd.PMT_STS_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fcd
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fcd.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_auths,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED') AS declined_auths
    FROM auth_2025
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN total_auths = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (declined_auths::numeric / total_auths) * 100 END AS declined_percentage
FROM counts;

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name, COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS escalated_complaints_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaints_count DESC;

SELECT chnl.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, SUM(fee.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_FEE fee
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fee.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST cust ON fee.CUST_K = cust.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy ON fee.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST chnl ON fee.CHNL_K = chnl.CUST_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY chnl.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY chnl.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT SUM(TXN_AMT) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dsp.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT aml
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR jur ON aml.JUR_K = jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON aml.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE aml.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY jur.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

WITH target_date AS (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LN_ID) AS loans_more_than_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS
WHERE DYS_PST_DUE > 90
  AND BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM target_date);

WITH target_date AS (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
),
-- Get the latest disbursement per loan and product on or before target date
latest_disb AS (
    SELECT LN_PRD_K, LN_ID, MAX(BUS_DT_K) AS max_dt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS
    WHERE BUS_DT_K <= (SELECT DT_K FROM target_date)
    GROUP BY LN_PRD_K, LN_ID
),
-- Sum outstanding principal from disbursements on or before target date
disb_outstanding AS (
    SELECT d.LN_PRD_K, SUM(d.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS d
    INNER JOIN latest_disb ld ON d.LN_PRD_K = ld.LN_PRD_K AND d.LN_ID = ld.LN_ID AND d.BUS_DT_K = ld.max_dt
    GROUP BY d.LN_PRD_K
)
SELECT p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name, COALESCE(o.total_outstanding, 0) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p
LEFT JOIN disb_outstanding o ON p.LN_PRD_K = o.LN_PRD_K
WHERE p.IS_CURR = TRUE
ORDER BY loan_product_name;

WITH atm_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        BR_K,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY BR_K
),
ranked_branches AS (
    SELECT
        a.BR_K,
        a.atm_txn_count,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.RGN_CD1 ORDER BY a.atm_txn_count DESC) AS rnk
    FROM atm_2025 a
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON a.BR_K = b.BR_K
    WHERE b.IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT
    b.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
    b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    r.atm_txn_count
FROM ranked_branches r
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON r.BR_K = b.BR_K
WHERE r.rnk = 1
  AND b.IS_CURR = TRUE
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT
  m.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
  SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_card_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH_CTG m ON f.MRCH_CTG_K = m.MRCH_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_card_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH transfers_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.CUST_K,
        SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY f.CUST_K
)
SELECT
    c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
    t.total_amount
FROM transfers_2025 t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
ORDER BY t.total_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

WITH atm_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_ATM_TXN.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
    WHERE D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
wr_trf_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_WR_TRF.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
    WHERE D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers_both_txn
FROM atm_customers
INNER JOIN wr_trf_customers USING (CUST_K);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.cal_yr_nbr AS year, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.cal_yr_nbr
ORDER BY d.cal_yr_nbr;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;

SELECT d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
       SUM(CAST(f_wr_trf.STLM_AMT AS NUMERIC)) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f_wr_trf
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_wr_trf.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY d_ccy ON f_wr_trf.CCY_K = d_ccy.CCY_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, COUNT(txn.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON txn.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT aml
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR jur ON aml.JUR_K = jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON aml.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY jur.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

SELECT br.BR_K, br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(atm.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.BR_K, br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_disputes_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH target_date AS (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
),
clients_in_default AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
    WHERE BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM target_date)
      AND DFLT_FLG = TRUE
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM clients_in_default;

SELECT d_cc.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, COUNT(f_c.CMPLT_F_K) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f_c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d_cc ON f_c.CMPLT_CTG_K = d_cc.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_c.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_cc.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
       AVG(f_fx_rt_d.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f_fx_rt_d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_fx_rt_d.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY d_ccy ON f_fx_rt_d.CCY_K = d_ccy.CCY_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY d_ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, ptf_val.MKT_ID AS market_id, SUM(ptf_val.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_portfolio_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D ptf_val
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON ptf_val.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR, ptf_val.MKT_ID
ORDER BY ptf_val.MKT_ID;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code, COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE OPND_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND OPND_DT < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT br.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON txn.BR_K = br.BR_K AND br.IS_CURR = TRUE
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

-- Find DT_K for 2025-06-30
WITH target_date AS (
    SELECT DT_K
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
    WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
),
-- Select closing balances for all accounts on that date
acct_balances AS (
    SELECT CLSNG_BAL_AMT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN target_date t ON f.BUS_DT_K = t.DT_K
    WHERE CLSNG_BAL_AMT IS NOT NULL
)
-- Calculate average closing balance
SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_account_closing_balance
FROM acct_balances;

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate_usd_dec_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH txn_2025_cust AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_K NOT IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM txn_2025_cust);

WITH auth_2025 AS (
    SELECT f.PMT_STS_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_auths,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED') AS declined_auths
    FROM auth_2025
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN total_auths = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (declined_auths::numeric / total_auths) * 100 END AS declined_percentage
FROM counts;

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name, COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS escalated_complaints_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaints_count DESC;

SELECT chnl.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, SUM(fee.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_FEE fee
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fee.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy ON fee.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST cust ON fee.CUST_K = cust.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST chnl ON fee.CHNL_K = chnl.CUST_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY chnl.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY chnl.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT SUM(TXN_AMT) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dsp.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT aml
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR jur ON aml.JUR_K = jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON aml.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE aml.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY jur.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

WITH target_date AS (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LN_ID) AS loans_more_than_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS
WHERE DYS_PST_DUE > 90
  AND BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM target_date);

WITH target_date AS (
    SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
),
-- Get the latest outstanding principal per loan (LN_ID) as of 2025-12-31 from disbursements and repayments
loan_balances AS (
    SELECT
        LN_ID,
        LN_PRD_K,
        MAX(BUS_DT_K) AS max_bus_dt_k
    FROM (
        SELECT LN_ID, LN_PRD_K, BUS_DT_K, OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT
        FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS
        WHERE BUS_DT_K <= (SELECT DT_K FROM target_date)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT LN_ID, LN_PRD_K, BUS_DT_K, OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT
        FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT
        WHERE BUS_DT_K <= (SELECT DT_K FROM target_date)
    ) combined
    GROUP BY LN_ID, LN_PRD_K
),
latest_balances AS (
    SELECT
        lb.LN_ID,
        lb.LN_PRD_K,
        COALESCE(dsb.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT, rpm.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT
    FROM loan_balances lb
    LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS dsb ON lb.LN_ID = dsb.LN_ID AND lb.LN_PRD_K = dsb.LN_PRD_K AND lb.max_bus_dt_k = dsb.BUS_DT_K
    LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT rpm ON lb.LN_ID = rpm.LN_ID AND lb.LN_PRD_K = rpm.LN_PRD_K AND lb.max_bus_dt_k = rpm.BUS_DT_K
),
-- Sum outstanding principal per loan product
sum_per_product AS (
    SELECT
        LN_PRD_K,
        SUM(OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
    FROM latest_balances
    GROUP BY LN_PRD_K
)
SELECT
    p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
    s.total_outstanding_principal
FROM sum_per_product s
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON s.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
ORDER BY loan_product_name;

WITH atm_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        BR_K,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY BR_K
),
max_atm_per_region AS (
    SELECT
        b.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        a.BR_K,
        a.atm_txn_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.RGN_CD1 ORDER BY a.atm_txn_count DESC) AS rn
    FROM atm_2025 a
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON a.BR_K = b.BR_K
    WHERE b.IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    (SELECT DSPLY_NM FROM bank_dwh.D_BR WHERE BR_K = max_atm_per_region.BR_K AND IS_CURR = TRUE) AS branch_name,
    atm_txn_count
FROM max_atm_per_region
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT f.MRCH_CTG_K, d.MRCH_CTG_CD1, SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH_CTG d ON f.MRCH_CTG_K = d.MRCH_CTG_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.MRCH_CTG_K, d.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_txn_amt DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH wire_transfers_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.CUST_K,
        SUM(COALESCE(f.STLM_AMT, 0)) AS total_wire_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY f.CUST_K
)
SELECT
    c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
    w.total_wire_amount
FROM wire_transfers_2025 w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
ORDER BY w.total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

WITH atm_customers_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_ATM_TXN.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
    WHERE D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
wr_trf_customers_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_WR_TRF.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
    WHERE D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers_both_txn_2025
FROM (
    SELECT CUST_K FROM atm_customers_2025
    INTERSECT
    SELECT CUST_K FROM wr_trf_customers_2025
) AS both_txn_customers;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.cal_yr_nbr AS year, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.cal_yr_nbr
ORDER BY d.cal_yr_nbr;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;

SELECT d_ccy.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
       SUM(CAST(f_wr_trf.STLM_AMT AS NUMERIC)) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f_wr_trf
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_wr_trf.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY d_ccy ON f_wr_trf.CCY_K = d_ccy.CCY_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_ccy.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY d_ccy.CCY_CD1;
